# Lantern

A scratch project for hearing back from another workspace.

messages.text: Done. I suggested a small check below; start it and I will be told when it is finished.

suggestions.title: Say ready
suggestions.why: A one-line check that the new workspace's agent starts and finishes.
suggestions.prompt: Reply with the single word ready. Do not read, run or change anything.

suggestions.title: Brighten the lamp
suggestions.why: The lamp setting is read before the config loads.
suggestions.prompt: Read the lamp setting after the config loads.

messages.text: Cut the release once the importer is ready.
